scientific_integrity: Takagi factorization and the Ky Fan/decreasing-rearrangement inequality are classical; no assertion of absolute priority or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional conjugate-linear operators only; no reconstruction of skew coefficient or Takagi basis. Dimension one is excluded. A formula in unindexed literature remains a priority risk. Numerical tests are ancillary to analytic proof.
title: Exact finite-dimensional antilinear trace disks and Takagi-spectrum tomography
